scope: two-mode passive Gaussian Markov system; fixed A, fixed monitored coupling, fixed hidden damping Gram matrix and fixed nondegenerate hidden bath occupation spectrum; only hidden channel-to-system coupling orientation varies

interpretation: The fixed-response noise-information freedom survives quotienting out internal-state realization gauge: every fibre member has the same deterministic state-space matrices A and C_m. The moving degree of freedom is the orientation of a fixed anisotropic environmental state relative to a coupling factorization with fixed damping Gram matrix.
claim_boundary: This witness does not establish literature novelty by itself.
Changing environmental channel orientation can be viewed as reservoir engineering; the PRL target must be a general realizability theorem/body, not this example.
The information quantity is a shot-noise-normalized coherent-displacement information and is proportional to displacement QFI under the stated passive Gaussian convention.
The next theorem gate should characterize the image of C^† N C at fixed C^† C and then propagate it through the detector transfer to noise/QFI reachable sets.
